_doc: Event sources for the note-driven library (scenes/blender/lib/sr_anim.py, from Sandbox Rhapsody), and which machine each drives (C4). Sources are config/event_sources.json's instruments, approved at C3.

stars.rig: reveal: births on the melody (top line), a planned count per section (human, C3)

rocking chair.rig: one rock per bar on the downbeats, steady; stops at the pen scratch

mobile.rig: stepper on downbeats; pieces lower on their nouns (N12)

mail slot flap.rig: clatters on each beat of N18
